requirements.scope: Place takes, use a take here, flatten unused takes, one Undo per edit.

requirements.name: Fades, alignment and consolidation
requirements.scope: Clip fades, first-transient grid alignment, consolidate window and fades.

requirements.name: Time stretching and warping

requirements.scope: Complete suite, module gate and packaged verification before replacing the distribution.
